facts.text: Founded in New Orleans by Mother Katharine Drexel, Xavier University of Louisiana is the nation's only Catholic historically black university.

sources.title: Drexel, Mother Katharine – Cause for Sainthood Collection - XULA Special Collections
sources.quote: In 1915, Mother Katharine Drexel founded Xavier Normal School in New Orleans, which became Xavier University of Louisiana (the nation's only Catholic historically black university) in 1925.
